tasks.description: Verify all AR invoices are recorded correctly, identify overdue invoices, and calculate revenue projections
Analyze cashflow transactions for unusual patterns or significant deviations from normal operations
Match bank transactions with ledger entries
Ensure all period expenses are properly accrued
Record monthly depreciation for fixed assets
Prepare P&L, balance sheet, and cashflow statement
Final review and approval of month-end close package

notes: Invoice Insights Agent should identify any collection issues early in the close process
Cashflow Anomaly Agent should flag unusual transactions for manual review
All anomalies and overdue invoices should be documented in the close package
